titulo: Texas executes death-row prisoner over 2005 triple killing
cuerpo: Ker’Sean Ramey, 41, died by lethal injection, the sixth person to be executed by Texas officials this year A man found guilty of fatally shooting three people during a 2005 attempted robbery at a rural Texas home was executed Wednesday, a week after the other man convicted in the killings was put to death. Ker’Sean Ramey, 41, died by lethal injection at the state penitentiary in Huntsville. He is the sixth person executed so far this year in Texas, with three more people scheduled over the next two months. Continue reading...
